user.title: Connect to OpenCode
user.description: Enter an OpenCode Go API key. Create or manage keys in the OpenCode Console after subscribing to Go.

data_description.api_key: Stored in your Home Assistant configuration and sent only to opencode.ai.

model.title: Choose a model
model.description: Pick the model for the first OpenCode assistant. You can add more assistants with other models later.

data_description.model: Only models available to your subscription with a verified API family are listed. A note after a model name describes how OpenCode handles your prompts.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate OpenCode
reauth_confirm.description: The OpenCode API key was rejected. Enter a valid key for the same account.

reconfigure.title: Update OpenCode API key
reconfigure.description: Enter a new API key for this OpenCode account.

error.usage_limit: OpenCode usage limit reached. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This API key is already configured

data_description.name: A name for this agent, for example the room or purpose it serves.
data_description.model: Certified models available to your subscription. A note after a model name describes how OpenCode handles your prompts.
data_description.custom_model: Optional. Use a model ID that is not in the list above, for example a newly released model.
data_description.api_family: Which API the model speaks. Leave on Automatic unless you use a custom model.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Off by default. Select Assist to let the model control your home. Any text the model reads, such as entity names and states, can influence those actions. Leave empty for a chat-only agent.
data_description.prompt: Optional extra instructions added to every request.
data_description.max_tokens: Upper limit for tokens the model may generate per response.

abort.entry_not_loaded: The OpenCode integration is not loaded. Start it before adding agents.

init.title: AI task
init.description: Configure this OpenCode AI task entity.

data_description.name: A name for this AI task entity.
data_description.model: Certified models available to your subscription. A note after a model name describes how OpenCode handles your prompts.
data_description.custom_model: Optional. Use a model ID that is not in the list above.
data_description.api_family: Which API the model speaks. Leave on Automatic unless you use a custom model.
data_description.max_tokens: Upper limit for tokens the model may generate per task.

abort.entry_not_loaded: The OpenCode integration is not loaded. Start it before adding AI tasks.

authentication_error.message: OpenCode rejected the API key. Please reauthenticate the integration.

invalid_structured_response.message: OpenCode returned an invalid structured response.

model_unavailable.message: Model {model} is no longer available on OpenCode Go.

protocol_unsupported.message: Model {model} does not support the configured API family. Check the agent options.

rate_limit.message: OpenCode usage limit reached for {model}. Try again later.

rate_limit_retry.message: OpenCode usage limit reached for {model}. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
